problems.reason: Sentence 4 claims the genus lived from 152.21 to 149.2 Ma during the Kimmeridgian stage, but 149.2 Ma is in the Berriasian (Early Cretaceous), contradicting the earlier statement that the range extends into the Early Cretaceous and the Kimmeridgian is a Late Jurassic stage.

notes: - contradiction: "Lusitanisuchus coexisted with many dinosaurs in the Lusitanian Basin during the Late Jurassic and Early Cretaceous." / "Teeth found at Porto Dinheiro, Lourinhã in Berriasian strata extend the known temporal range of the taxon by about 15 million years. The genus lived from 152.21 to 149.2 million years ago during the Kimmeridgian stage.": Sentence 4 claims the genus lived from 152.21 to 149.2 Ma during the Kimmeridgian stage, but 149.2 Ma is in the Berriasian (Early Cretaceous), contradicting the earlier statement that the range extends into the Early Cretaceous and the Kimmeridgian is a Late Jurassic stage.
